name: toonflow
description: Toonflow 是一款 AI 短剧漫剧工具，能够利用 AI 技术将小说自动转化为剧本，并结合 AI 生成的图片和视频，实现高效的短剧创作。
author: HBAI-Ltd <ltlctools@outlook.com>

scripts.build: bun run build:tools && bun run build:ext && bun run --filter '@toonflow/web' --filter '@toonflow/server' build
scripts.build:nodes: bun -e "import { rmSync } from '@toonflow/file'; import { resolve } from 'node:path'; rmSync(resolve('build/nodes'), { recursive: true, force: true });" && NODE_ENV=production bun run --filter './packages/nodes/*' build
scripts.build:ext: bun -e "import { rmSync } from '@toonflow/file'; import { resolve } from 'node:path'; rmSync(resolve('build/ext'), { recursive: true, force: true });" && NODE_ENV=production bun run --filter './packages/ext/*' build
scripts.build:tools: bun -e "import { rmSync } from '@toonflow/file'; import { resolve } from 'node:path'; rmSync(resolve('build/tools'), { recursive: true, force: true });" && NODE_ENV=production bun run --filter './packages/tools/*' build
